about_the_game:
Master aerial acrobatics and bend time to your will in this roguelite, where strategic depth meets intense acrobatic gameplay. Travel through time to unlock powerful synergies with upgrades that turn you into a godlike sky matador. Gear up, pilot—it's time to rule the skies.

Aerial Acrobatics

Master momentum-based flight to perform aerial acrobatics with precision and flair.

Customize your journey with pilots boasting distinct arsenals and abilities, tailoring your gameplay to your strategic preferences.

Rewind the Clock

Harness the power of time itself. Rewind to erase your mistakes or orchestrate flawless strategies, and attack your foes from multiple angles with your time-duplicated self.

Slice through the sky

Decelerate the flow of time and slice through enemies at blistering speeds, leaving nothing but destruction in your wake.

Unleash Unparalleled Synergies

Discover and combine over 50+ upgrades to unlock potent synergies. Mix and match your arsenal to enhance precision with homing bullets or channel the fury of the gods with electrifying dominance.

Features:

  • Choose from 5 distinctive pilots, each with unique abilities and playstyles.

  • Explore over 50 transformative run upgrades, designed to create dynamic synergies.

  • Customize your approach with permanent perks and power-ups for each pilot, tailoring their capabilities to embody either an offensive juggernaut or a defensive fortress.

  • Enjoy seamless gameplay with full integrated controller support.

  • Elevate the challenge with higher difficulties.

  • Strive for greatness with a host of achievements that reward your mastery and ambition.
